name: branding-angular-a-letter-wordmark-with-takeaway-packaging
title: Line-built AIZA wordmark with pink sticker on a kraft bag and chopstick sleeve
whatItIs: A white slide with a black wordmark 'AIZA' whose As are open triangles without crossbars, then two photos: a kraft paper bag with a cream round sticker bearing a pink A on a hot-pink tile background, and a chopstick sleeve printed with the repeated wordmark on yellow.
whatItMeans: Precise and playful; open As suggest chopsticks or roof shapes and make a light logo distinctive.
techniques: Drop crossbars from the A to create an open, architectural letter.
Use a single letter as the sticker mark.
Photograph packaging on bright flat colours.
Repeat the wordmark as a pattern on sleeves.

vocabulary.definition: An A drawn without a crossbar.
A round sticker closing a bag.
A logo repeated as a pattern.
Product on a flat saturated background.
